title: AIExtractionOutput
description: Structured output from the AI financial report analysis (Spec D07 §4.2)

asset_match.description: true if the PDF's subject company matches the given Asset Context (ticker/name); false if the document is clearly about a different company

asset_match_notes.description: Required when asset_match is false: which company the PDF actually appears to be about. Null when asset_match is true.

report_date.description: ISO 8601 date of the financial report, or null if not determinable

report_period_name.description: Short label for the accounting period the report covers (e.g. 'Q1 2026', 'FY 2025', 'H1 2026'), or null if not determinable

per_basis.description: Which EPS basis was used to calculate PER

roe.description: Return on Equity as a decimal fraction (e.g. 0.15 for 15%), or null

revenue_growth_yoy.description: Year-over-year revenue growth as a decimal (e.g. 0.08 for +8%), or null

management_tone.description: Tone of CEO/CFO language and forward guidance

fundamentals_signal.description: Signal derived from quantitative results (growth, margins, leverage)

executive_summary_es.description: 3-5 bullet-point summary of the report's key findings, in Spanish

executive_summary_en.description: 3-5 bullet-point summary of the report's key findings, in English

global_signal.description: Overall investment signal derived from the report

confidence_notes.description: Optional notes on data quality, missing fields, or approximations used

calculations_detail.description: Per-metric explanation of inputs, formula, sources, and caveats

data_provenance.description: For each key input, records whether it came from the PDF or the system
